passages.text: The Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations (“MD&A”) should be read in conjunction with the financial statements and the notes thereto included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. The MD&A contains forward-looking statements within the meaning of Section 27A of the Securities Act and Section 21E of the Exchange Act that involve risks and uncertainties, which are discussed under Part I, Item 1A. Overview The ability to accurately measure and reference time has been essential to humankind’s greatest inventions and technological advances. Timing technology has continued to evolve over centuries, underpinning broader technological evolution and is the heartbeat of digital electronic systems. Timing ensures that the system runs smoothly and reliably by providing and distributing clock signals to various critical components such as central processing units, communication and interface ICs, and radio frequency components. As electronics evolve to deliver higher performance, connectivity, and intelligence, even in increasingly challenging environments, while also being more complex and size-constrained, we believe they will require more sophisticated semiconductor-based timing solutions that cannot be developed in legacy quartz crystal-based technologies. Precision timing, a category that SiTime created ("Precision Timing") fills this need with the performance, resilience, reliability, power, size, and cost that is required by these applications. We are a leading provider of Precision Timing solutions to the global electronics industry. Our Precision Timing products are the heartbeat of our customers’ electronic systems, providing the timing functionality that is needed for electronics to operate reliably and accurately. We provide Precision Timing solutions that are differentiated by high performance, high resilience, and high reliability, along with programmability, small size, and low power consumption. Our products have been designed into over 400 applications across our target markets, including artificial intelligence ("AI") systems, datacenter, communications, enterprise, automotive, industrial, aerospace, defense, mobile, Internet of Things (“IoT”), and consumer. Our current solutions include various types of oscillators, as well as clock integrated circuits (“ICs”), resonators, and synchronization software. We believe that the total timing market is approximately $11 billion in size and growing. Since our founding, we have focused on the high-end portion of the market, i.e. Precision Timing. Historically, our revenue has been substantially derived from sale of oscillator systems across our target end markets. In 2025, we have benefitted from the strong growth in AI datacenter deployments. Our all-silicon solutions are based on four fundamental areas of technical expertise: micro-electro-mechanical systems (“MEMS”), analog mixed-signal design, advanced system-level integration, and software. credit_strengths.text: Revenue has compounded sharply across the last three fiscal years, with the latest period reflecting strong demand from AI datacenter deployments. This top-line momentum, combined with a high current ratio, gives the issuer substantial near-term liquidity and supports its ability to fund working capital and product development without external borrowing.

Operating cash flow has strengthened materially over the same period, turning free cash flow positive after capital expenditure. The issuer funds its own investment program internally, and the absence of reported funded debt means cash generation is not absorbed by interest or principal payments, leaving room for strategic reinvestment.

key_risks.text: The issuer remains loss-making at the operating line, with an operating margin below the sector median, and its EBITDA proxy is negative. Profitability depends on scaling revenue faster than operating costs, and any slowdown in AI datacenter demand or pricing pressure could delay the path to positive operating income.

Disclosures highlight dependence on a limited number of customers and end customers, alongside risks tied to new product development and design wins. Concentration means a single program cancellation or inventory correction could pressure revenue and cash flow, while the capital-intensive product roadmap requires sustained investment to defend its precision timing position.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: No funded debt is reported for the balance-sheet date, and the debt note indicates borrowings may be nil, so traditional coverage and leverage ratios are not meaningful. Liquidity is instead anchored by cash and a very high current ratio, which comfortably covers near-term obligations.

Interest expense is not tagged in the filing, so interest coverage cannot be computed from the bundle. This is a material data gap for assessing any future borrowing, but with no reported debt and positive free cash flow, the issuer currently has no fixed debt-service burden to meet.

overall_credit_view.text: The credit profile is supported by strong revenue growth, positive free cash flow and a debt-free balance sheet, but constrained by operating losses and negative EBITDA. The indicative financial risk profile is not meaningful on leverage, so the assessment rests on liquidity runway and the path to profitability.

Our forward view is that the issuer can self-fund its investment program while revenue scales, provided AI datacenter demand holds and customer concentration does not crystallize. We would monitor operating margin progression and any future debt issuance, since the absence of interest expense disclosure limits visibility on debt-service capacity.

credit_strengths.text: 過去三個財政年度收入均大幅複合增長，最近一期反映來自AI數據中心部署的強勁需求。此收入動力結合高流動比率，為發行人提供充裕的短期流動性，並支持其在不依賴外部借貸的情況下為營運資金及產品開發提供資金的能力。
經營現金流於同期顯著增強，在資本開支後轉為自由現金流正數。發行人以內部資金支持自身投資計劃，且並無呈報有息債務，意味現金產生不會被利息或本金付款所吸收，為策略性再投資留有空間。

key_risks.text: 發行人於經營層面仍錄得虧損，經營利潤率低於行業中位數，且其EBITDA代理指標為負數。盈利能力取決於收入增長快於經營成本，而AI數據中心需求放緩或定價壓力均可能延遲其達致經營溢利的進程。
披露文件強調其依賴有限數目的客戶及終端客戶，同時存在與新產品開發及設計中標相關的風險。集中度意味單一項目取消或庫存調整可能對收入及現金流構成壓力，而資本密集的產品路線圖需要持續投資以維護其精確定時定位。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 於資產負債表日期並無呈報有息債務，且債務附註顯示借貸可能為零，因此傳統的覆蓋率及槓桿比率並不具意義。流動性反而以現金及極高的流動比率為錨，足以從容覆蓋短期債務。
利息開支並未於申報文件中標示，因此無法從資料組合計算利息覆蓋率。此為評估任何未來借貸的重要數據缺口，但由於並無呈報債務且自由現金流為正數，發行人目前並無固定的債務償付負擔需要履行。

overall_credit_view.text: 信用狀況受強勁收入增長、正自由現金流及無債務資產負債表所支持，但受經營虧損及負EBITDA所限制。指示性財務風險狀況在槓桿方面並不具意義，因此評估依賴流動性跑道及達致盈利的路徑。
我們的前瞻觀點是，只要AI數據中心需求維持且客戶集中度風險未有實現，發行人可在收入增長的同時自行資助其投資計劃。我們將監察經營利潤率的進展及任何未來債務發行，因為缺乏利息開支披露限制了對債務償付能力的可見度。
